T=G['Test input']
def transform(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); o=[row[:] for row in g]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2]
    def between(a,b):
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=a,b
        if not (r1==r2 or c1==c2): return None
        dr=(r2>r1)-(r2<r1); dc=(c2>c1)-(c2<c1)
        n=max(abs(r2-r1),abs(c2-c1))
        cells=[]
        for k in range(1,n):
            r=r1+dr*k; c=c1+dc*k
            if g[r][c]==1: cells.append((r,c))
            elif g[r][c]!=2: return None
        return cells
    fill=set()
    for a,b in itertools.combinations(pts,2):
        cells=between(a,b)
        if cells: fill|=set(cells)
    for r,c in fill: o[r][c]=3
    return o
assert transform(inp)==out
